Seems like the driver "amdgpu" is part of the Kernel itself..?

I'm using latest Xanmod Kernel specific for the AMD FX architecture.. 
6.12.56-rt-x64v2-xanmod1 // x64v2= AMD FX

I recall trying to install Xanmod on Archlinux, 
at that moment there wasnt an x64v2 version available on arch repos, so I didnt dare installing the regular one..

But I guess it can be done!

It works flawlessly here in Debian so I can only reccomend it,
but ofc depending on your hardware and distro ymmv ;)
